name: patient_has_finding_of_biliary_colic_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever had a history of biliary colic (biliary pain).
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever had a history of biliary colic (biliary pain) at any point in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never had a history of biliary colic (biliary pain).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever had a history of biliary colic (biliary pain).
